## Scope

Describe the user-visible behavior and the ownership boundary changed by this
pull request. Link tracker findings and product/security decisions where they
apply.

## Verification

- [ ] Generated sources were regenerated rather than edited.
- [ ] `make lint` passes with warnings and infos fatal.
- [ ] Relevant behavior, failure, lifecycle, and accessibility tests pass.
- [ ] Android and iOS host integration compile where platform code changed.
- [ ] No secret, fixture wallet data, fake success, or non-idempotent retry was added.
- [ ] Release configuration, artifact, privacy, and signing implications were reviewed.
- [ ] Tracker rows and documentation match the exact implementation.

## Evidence

Record the exact commands, devices or runners, artifact digests, screenshots,
performance measurements, and any honest blocker or accepted constraint.
